# CV Buana Bahtera Inspectindo

## Canonical Website
https://surveyorbbi.co.id/

## Languages
English pages are available at the site root. Indonesian pages are available under https://surveyorbbi.co.id/id/. Pages use reciprocal hreflang metadata for English and Indonesian discovery.

## Company Summary
CV Buana Bahtera Inspectindo, also known as BBI, is an independent surveyor company in Indonesia. The company was established in September 2021 and provides survey, inspection, supervision, sampling, laboratory-support, and reporting services for marine, cargo, bulk, agricultural product, and insurance assignments.

## Service Areas
BBI serves Indonesian operating areas from a head office in Jakarta Utara with branch presence in Pontianak Utara, Kalimantan Barat, and Bekasi.

## Main Services
- Marine survey: towing and lashing, lashing survey, on/off hire vessel survey, bunker survey, physical general condition survey, hold cleanliness, draft survey, investigation, stowage, and stability.
- Cargo survey: tally loading and unloading, break bulk cargo and container checks, condition or damage survey, measuring of shipping cargo, pre-loading survey, weighing, and sampling.
- Bulk survey: hatch cleanliness, hose test, pre-bulk, weighing, sampling, and bunkering.
- Agricultural product survey: loading and discharging supervision, pre-shipment survey, sampling, analytical support, and testing laboratory coordination.
- Independent laboratory services: FOSFA-oriented laboratory capability and equipment for palm oil product testing.
- Insurance survey: physical general condition survey, vessel hull and machinery condition or damage survey, and valuation support.
